title: Bohr-type inequalities with Fréchet derivative and Area terms in Complex Banach spaces
summary: We establish new Bohr-type inequalities for holomorphic mappings from the unit ball of a complex Banach space into the closed unit disk. Using Fréchet derivatives, Schwarz mappings of prescribed orders and area functionals, we obtain sharp Bohr radii characterized by explicit equations. We further prove a refined Bohr inequality involving derivative, coefficient and area terms and show that the corresponding radius is the unique positive solution of $r^m=(\sqrt{17}-3)/4$.
